candidates.claim_text: # Bags Split the Job: Mini Bags Draw the Eye, Large Bags Carry the Load
issues: Ledger supports visual impact for very small bags and functionality for selected larger bags, but does not establish a general 2026 division of labor between mini and large bags.
candidates.model_claim: # Bags Split the Job: Mini Bags Draw the Eye, Large Bags Carry the Load

candidates.claim_text: Looking at fashion for 2026, mini bags are having a big moment.
issues: ELLE described mini bags as a major Fall 2026 styling direction, but the article broadens this single-outlet coverage into a general claim about fashion for all of 2026.
candidates.model_claim: Looking at fashion for 2026, mini bags are having a big moment.

candidates.claim_text: Palm-sized clutches, small pouches, and eye-catching minaudières are all over runways and fashion reports.
issues: The sources identify examples in selected collections and reports, but do not support the claim that these styles are “all over” runways and fashion reports.
candidates.model_claim: Palm-sized clutches, small pouches, and eye-catching minaudières are all over runways and fashion reports.

candidates.claim_text: Some are so small that you might ask, “Can you really fit anything in that?”
issues: The rhetorical question implies that some bags may not fit anything; the ledger gives selected examples of miniature designs but does not establish that implication.
candidates.model_claim: Some are so small that you might ask, “Can you really fit anything in that?”

candidates.claim_text: But this is not a takeover, with mini bags pushing large bags out.
issues: The ledger documents coexistence of small and large styles in selected coverage, but does not establish a market-wide conclusion that mini bags are not pushing large bags out.
candidates.model_claim: But this is not a takeover, with mini bags pushing large bags out.

candidates.claim_text: In 2026, the two sizes seem to have different jobs.
issues: Different functional “jobs” are an interpretation not directly established as a general feature of bags in 2026; the ledger describes particular small-bag appeal and selected large-bag functionality.
candidates.model_claim: In 2026, the two sizes seem to have different jobs.

candidates.claim_text: One carries what we need.
issues: The broad claim that large bags carry everything “we need” is not established by the limited examples of functional larger bags in the ledger.
candidates.model_claim: One carries what we need.

candidates.claim_text: They mainly hold the basics: a phone, wallet, keys, and lip products.
issues: ELLE linked the appeal of very small bags to carrying a limited set of essentials; it did not establish that the cited bags mainly hold those items or have that capacity.
candidates.model_claim: They mainly hold the basics: a phone, wallet, keys, and lip products.

candidates.claim_text: They do not challenge roomy bags on storage.
issues: The ledger describes small bags' value as being visual rather than storage capacity, but does not directly compare their storage with roomy bags or establish that they do not challenge them.
candidates.model_claim: They do not challenge roomy bags on storage.

candidates.claim_text: The season’s picture becomes clearer when we look at what appeared beside them.
issues: The sentence claims that looking at the accompanying bags makes the season's picture clearer; the ledger supports their co-appearance, not that this comparison causes greater clarity.
candidates.model_claim: The season’s picture becomes clearer when we look at what appeared beside them.
